item.title: How Does Saudi Arabia See the War with Iran?
item.description: Saudi Arabia finds itself in an unprecedented war with Iran. Not surprisingly, Saudi views of this war are complicated.

item.title: CSIS Names Thamar Harrigan Chief of Staff of the Economic Security and Technology Department
item.description: The Center for Strategic and International Studies today announced that Thamar Harrigan has joined the CSIS Economic Security and Technology (EST) Department as chief of staff and director of operations.

item.title: States Weekly Newsletter: March 18, 2026
item.description: This edition of States Weekly covers March 18, 2026.

item.title: SBIR and STTR Reauthorization and the Future of Small Business Innovation
item.description: The United States Senate has passed legislation to reauthorize the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) programs through fiscal year 2031, though challenges remain to catalyze the long-term growth of small businesses.

item.title: Abracadabra
item.description: This week, Bill Reinsch analyzes the impact of the war on Iran on energy supply chains, foreign investment, and global manufacturing.

item.title: Government as a Demand Creator for the Quantum Industry
item.description: To secure quantum leadership, the federal government should act as a credible demand creator—not just a funder of research and development and an ecosystem enabler. A federal funding ladder de-risks private investment and carries quantum technologies across the valley of death.

item.title: Investing in National Assets for Quantum Commercialization
item.description: Decades of public investment, world class research institutions, and the emergence of multiple high-performing regional innovation ecosystems have positioned the United States as a leader in quantum. Yet this position is neither assured nor self-sustaining.
